mentions.description: An infrastructure setup for hosting static webpages with additional capabilities — data storage, users, notifications, shared "rooms", and other features — all exposed behind an MCP. It is assembled from free-tier AWS static services, making it practically $0 to run. Built for the author's own use, with the option to grant access to friends and family.
mentions.problem: Enabling dynamic features (data storage, users, notifications, shared rooms) on top of static webpage hosting at practically zero cost by using free AWS static services.
mentions.audience: Personal use by the builder, with access shareable to friends and family.
mentions.author: aviperl
